tasks.spec: Do nothing. Do not edit, create or delete any file, and do not run any command. The check runs the freytag-forge hosted L1 @affordances test on staging for scene 1A with 3 replicates and checks it completed and wrote its report. Reply with the single word: ready.

tasks.verified: 3 hosted L1 replicates of 1A completed and the report was written.
